name: Toma Brine
seed: To find a lost harbor chart and retire with a vessel that belongs to its crew.
design: Sea otter, silver whiskers, indigo sea coat, coral sash, polished shell compass.
history: Raised by reef gardeners, became a salvage captain and bought a ship with a crew cooperative.
desire: To find a lost harbor chart and retire with a vessel that belongs to its crew.
contradiction: Calls salvage fair discovery even when living families have prior claims.
relationships: Maela needs his archive passage; Sela respects his weather judgment; Namu disputes a mineral charter.
arc: Returns a claim voluntarily and accepts a smaller share in an expedition governed by descendants.
story_engine: A submerged feast hall opens for one tide; a rival rescue crew arrives first and deserves the credit.
writer_truth: His best chart was copied from a community archive without proper permission.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
